title: Quick Norwegian Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with tender beef and a hint of Norwegian flair.
instructions: Heat the beef broth in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the quick zesty sauce, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
